summary: Gap-up openings occurred in 46/69 observations; 39/69 closed above the previous close. The median session return was +0.122%. Bullish intraday candles occurred in 31/69 sessions. The following session was positive in 38/69 available observations. Ordinary-session positive frequency over the same date span was 53.8% (includes event sessions). Three-session direction reversed in 35/69 observations with nonzero prior and subsequent returns. Nakshatra and Gandamool intervals use the first overlapping regular session; nested events are not independent confirmations. These descriptive results do not establish a predictive edge.
